import CompRewards.Spec
namespace CompRewards

def supplyCond (s : St) (who : Account) : Prop :=
  s.supplyState.block ≤ s.blockNumber ∧
  accrualStart (s.acct who).supplierIndex
    (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index ≤
    (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index

def borrowCond (s : St) (who : Account) : Prop :=
  s.borrowState.block ≤ s.blockNumber ∧
  accrualStart (s.acct who).borrowerIndex
    (accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)).index ≤
    (accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)).index

instance instDecSupply (s : St) (who : Account) : Decidable (supplyCond s who) := by
  unfold supplyCond; infer_instance

instance instDecBorrow (s : St) (who : Account) : Decidable (borrowCond s who) := by
  unfold borrowCond; infer_instance

def setCond (s : St) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  (s.supplyState.speed ≠ a → s.supplyState.block ≤ s.blockNumber) ∧
  (s.borrowState.speed ≠ b → s.borrowState.block ≤ s.blockNumber)

instance instDecSet (s : St) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (setCond s a b) := by
  unfold setCond; infer_instance

def supplyStep (s : St) (who : Account) : St :=
  { s with
    supplyState := accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s),
    accts := s.accts.modify who fun a =>
      ({ a with
        supplierIndex := (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index,
        accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.supply
          (accrualStart a.supplierIndex (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index)
          (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index } : Acct) }

def borrowStep (s : St) (who : Account) : St :=
  { s with
    borrowState := accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s),
    accts := s.accts.modify who fun a =>
      ({ a with
        borrowerIndex := (accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)).index,
        accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
          (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex (accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)).index)
          (accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)).index } : Acct) }

def setStep (s : St) (a b : Nat) : St :=
  { s with
    supplyState := (if s.supplyState.speed = a then s.supplyState
      else ({ accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s) with speed := a } : Side)),
    borrowState := (if s.borrowState.speed = b then s.borrowState
      else ({ accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s) with speed := b } : Side)) }

def comptroller : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .supplyHook who => if supplyCond s who then some (supplyStep s who) else none
  | .borrowHook who => if borrowCond s who then some (borrowStep s who) else none
  | .claim who =>
    if _hB : borrowCond s who then
      if _hS : supplyCond (borrowStep s who) who then
        some (grant (supplyStep (borrowStep s who) who) who)
      else none
    else none
  | .setSpeeds a b => if setCond s a b then some (setStep s a b) else none

theorem req_supply_hook : SupplyHookEffects comptroller := by
  intro s who s' h
  simp only [comptroller] at h
  by_cases hc : supplyCond s who
  · simp only [hc, ite_true] at h
    obtain rfl := Option.some_inj.mp h
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨hc1, hc2, rfl⟩
  · simp only [hc, ite_false] at h
    contradiction

theorem req_borrow_hook : BorrowHookEffects comptroller := by
  intro s who s' h
  simp only [comptroller] at h
  by_cases hc : borrowCond s who
  · simp only [hc, ite_true] at h
    obtain rfl := Option.some_inj.mp h
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨hc1, hc2, rfl⟩
  · simp only [hc, ite_false] at h
    contradiction

theorem req_claim : ClaimEffects comptroller := by
  intro s who s' h
  simp only [comptroller] at h
  by_cases hB : borrowCond s who
  · simp only [hB, dite_true] at h
    by_cases hS : supplyCond (borrowStep s who) who
    · simp only [hS, dite_true] at h
      obtain rfl := Option.some_inj.mp h
      obtain ⟨hB1, hB2⟩ := hB
      obtain ⟨hS1, hS2⟩ := hS
      exact ⟨borrowStep s who, supplyStep (borrowStep s who) who,
        ⟨hB1, hB2, rfl⟩, ⟨hS1, hS2, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · simp only [hS, dite_false] at h
      contradiction
  · simp only [hB, dite_false] at h
    contradiction

theorem req_set_speeds : SetSpeedsEffects comptroller := by
  intro s a b s' h
  simp only [comptroller] at h
  by_cases hc : setCond s a b
  · simp only [hc, ite_true] at h
    obtain rfl := Option.some_inj.mp h
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨fun hne => hc1 hne, fun hne => hc2 hne, rfl⟩
  · simp only [hc, ite_false] at h
    contradiction

theorem accrue_ge (sd : Side) (now total : Nat) :
    sd.index ≤ (accrueSide sd now total).index := by
  unfold accrueSide
  by_cases h : (0 < now - sd.block ∧ 0 < sd.speed ∧ 0 < total)
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Nat.le_refl _

theorem accrue_block (sd : Side) (now total : Nat) :
    (accrueSide sd now total).block = now := by
  unfold accrueSide
  by_cases h : (0 < now - sd.block ∧ 0 < sd.speed ∧ 0 < total)
  · rw [if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h]

theorem accrualStart_le (rec idx : Nat) (h : rec ≤ idx) :
    accrualStart rec idx ≤ idx := by
  unfold accrualStart
  by_cases hr : rec = 0
  · subst hr
    simp only [ite_true]
    by_cases hi : compInitialIndex ≤ idx
    · rw [if_pos hi]; exact hi
    · rw [if_neg hi]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  · rw [if_neg hr]; exact h

theorem getD_mem_of_lt (l : List Acct) (n : Nat) (h : n < l.length) :
    l.getD n noAcct ∈ l := by
  induction l generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      simp at h
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem hd (ih n h)

theorem getD_eq_default_of_not_lt (l : List Acct) (n : Nat) (h : ¬ n < l.length) :
    l.getD n noAcct = noAcct := by
  induction l generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp at h
    | succ n =>
      simp only [List.getD_cons_succ]
      apply ih
      simp at h ⊢
      omega

theorem mem_index_le_of_consistent (s : St) (hc0 : Consistent s) (who : Account)
    (hlt : who < s.accts.length) :
    (s.acct who).supplierIndex ≤ s.supplyState.index ∧
    (s.acct who).borrowerIndex ≤ s.borrowState.index := by
  have hmem : ∀ a ∈ s.accts,
      a.supplierIndex ≤ s.supplyState.index ∧ a.borrowerIndex ≤ s.borrowState.index :=
    hc0.2.2
  have hm := hmem _ (getD_mem_of_lt _ _ hlt)
  have heq : s.accts.getD who noAcct = s.acct who := rfl
  rw [heq] at hm
  exact hm

theorem acct_le_supply_of_consistent (s : St) (hc0 : Consistent s) (who : Account) :
    (s.acct who).supplierIndex ≤ s.supplyState.index := by
  by_cases hlt : who < s.accts.length
  · exact (mem_index_le_of_consistent s hc0 who hlt).1
  · have hget : s.accts.getD who noAcct = noAcct :=
      getD_eq_default_of_not_lt s.accts who hlt
    have heq : s.acct who = noAcct := by
      unfold St.acct
      exact hget
    rw [heq]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem acct_le_borrow_of_consistent (s : St) (hc0 : Consistent s) (who : Account) :
    (s.acct who).borrowerIndex ≤ s.borrowState.index := by
  by_cases hlt : who < s.accts.length
  · exact (mem_index_le_of_consistent s hc0 who hlt).2
  · have hget : s.accts.getD who noAcct = noAcct :=
      getD_eq_default_of_not_lt s.accts who hlt
    have heq : s.acct who = noAcct := by
      unfold St.acct
      exact hget
    rw [heq]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem supplyCond_of_consistent (s : St) (hc0 : Consistent s) (who : Account) :
    supplyCond s who := by
  unfold supplyCond
  have hsb : s.supplyState.block ≤ s.blockNumber := hc0.1
  refine ⟨hsb, ?_⟩
  have hle : (s.acct who).supplierIndex ≤ s.supplyState.index :=
    acct_le_supply_of_consistent s hc0 who
  have hge := accrue_ge s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)
  have hle2 : (s.acct who).supplierIndex ≤
      (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index :=
    Nat.le_trans hle hge
  exact accrualStart_le _ _ hle2

theorem borrowCond_of_consistent (s : St) (hc0 : Consistent s) (who : Account) :
    borrowCond s who := by
  unfold borrowCond
  have hbb : s.borrowState.block ≤ s.blockNumber := hc0.2.1
  refine ⟨hbb, ?_⟩
  have hle : (s.acct who).borrowerIndex ≤ s.borrowState.index :=
    acct_le_borrow_of_consistent s hc0 who
  have hge := accrue_ge s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)
  have hle2 : (s.acct who).borrowerIndex ≤
      (accrueSide s.borrowState s.blockNumber (totalBorrows s)).index :=
    Nat.le_trans hle hge
  exact accrualStart_le _ _ hle2

theorem setCond_of_consistent (s : St) (hc0 : Consistent s) (a b : Nat) :
    setCond s a b := by
  unfold setCond
  have hsb : s.supplyState.block ≤ s.blockNumber := hc0.1
  have hbb : s.borrowState.block ≤ s.blockNumber := hc0.2.1
  exact ⟨fun _ => hsb, fun _ => hbb⟩

theorem get_supplier_modify (l : List Acct) (who : Nat) (f : Acct → Acct)
    (h : ∀ a, (f a).supplierIndex = a.supplierIndex) :
    ((l.modify who f).getD who noAcct).supplierIndex = (l.getD who noAcct).supplierIndex := by
  induction l generalizing who with
  | nil =>
    cases who with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    cases who with
    | zero =>
      have hm0 : (hd :: tl).modify 0 f = f hd :: tl := rfl
      simp only [hm0, List.getD_cons_zero]
      exact h hd
    | succ n =>
      have hm1 : (hd :: tl).modify (n + 1) f = hd :: tl.modify n f := rfl
      simp only [hm1, List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact ih n

theorem map_supply_modify_eq (l : List Acct) (who : Nat) (f : Acct → Acct)
    (h : ∀ a, (f a).supply = a.supply) :
    (List.map Acct.supply (l.modify who f)).sum = (List.map Acct.supply l).sum := by
  induction l generalizing who with
  | nil =>
    cases who with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    cases who with
    | zero =>
      have hm : (hd :: tl).modify 0 f = f hd :: tl := rfl
      rw [hm]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, h hd]
    | succ n =>
      have hm : (hd :: tl).modify (n + 1) f = hd :: tl.modify n f := rfl
      rw [hm]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih n]

theorem map_borrow_modify_eq (l : List Acct) (who : Nat) (f : Acct → Acct)
    (h : ∀ a, (f a).borrow = a.borrow) :
    (List.map Acct.borrow (l.modify who f)).sum = (List.map Acct.borrow l).sum := by
  induction l generalizing who with
  | nil =>
    cases who with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    cases who with
    | zero =>
      have hm : (hd :: tl).modify 0 f = f hd :: tl := rfl
      rw [hm]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, h hd]
    | succ n =>
      have hm : (hd :: tl).modify (n + 1) f = hd :: tl.modify n f := rfl
      rw [hm]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih n]

theorem totalSupply_borrowStep (s : St) (who : Account) :
    totalSupply (borrowStep s who) = totalSupply s := by
  unfold totalSupply borrowStep
  simp only
  apply map_supply_modify_eq
  intro a
  rfl

theorem supplyCond_borrowStep (s : St) (who : Account)
    (h1 : s.supplyState.block ≤ s.blockNumber)
    (h2 : accrualStart (s.acct who).supplierIndex
      (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index ≤
      (accrueSide s.supplyState s.blockNumber (totalSupply s)).index) :
    supplyCond (borrowStep s who) who := by
  unfold supplyCond
  have htot : totalSupply (borrowStep s who) = totalSupply s :=
    totalSupply_borrowStep s who
  have hblk : (borrowStep s who).blockNumber = s.blockNumber := rfl
  have hss : (borrowStep s who).supplyState = s.supplyState := rfl
  rw [hblk, hss, htot]
  have hsup : ((borrowStep s who).acct who).supplierIndex =
      (s.acct who).supplierIndex := by
    unfold St.acct borrowStep
    simp only
    apply get_supplier_modify
    intro a
    rfl
  rw [hsup]
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

theorem req_calls_succeed : CallsSucceed comptroller := by
  intro s c hcon
  cases c with
  | supplyHook who =>
    simp only [comptroller]
    have h := supplyCond_of_consistent s hcon who
    simp only [h, ite_true, Option.isSome_some]
  | borrowHook who =>
    simp only [comptroller]
    have h := borrowCond_of_consistent s hcon who
    simp only [h, ite_true, Option.isSome_some]
  | claim who =>
    simp only [comptroller]
    have hB := borrowCond_of_consistent s hcon who
    simp only [hB, dite_true]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := supplyCond_of_consistent s hcon who
    have hS := supplyCond_borrowStep s who h1 h2
    simp only [hS, dite_true, Option.isSome_some]
  | setSpeeds a b =>
    simp only [comptroller]
    have h := setCond_of_consistent s hcon a b
    simp only [h, ite_true, Option.isSome_some]

def sPend (s : St) (a : Acct) : Nat :=
  a.supply * (s.supplyState.index - accrualStart a.supplierIndex s.supplyState.index)
def bPend (s : St) (a : Acct) : Nat :=
  a.borrow * (s.borrowState.index - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
def Usup (s : St) : Nat := (s.blockNumber - s.supplyState.block) * s.supplyState.speed
def Ubor (s : St) : Nat := (s.blockNumber - s.borrowState.block) * s.borrowState.speed
def sumSP (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => sPend s a).sum
def sumBP (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => bPend s a).sum
def Ftot (s : St) : Nat :=
  (St.credited s) * doubleScale + sumSP s + sumBP s + (Usup s + Ubor s) * doubleScale
def Fwho (s : St) (who : Account) : Nat :=
  (St.creditedTo s who) * doubleScale + sPend s (s.acct who) + bPend s (s.acct who) +
    (if 0 < (s.acct who).supply then Usup s * doubleScale else 0) +
    (if 0 < (s.acct who).borrow then Ubor s * doubleScale else 0)

theorem accrualStart_mono {rec I Ip : Nat} (h : I ≤ Ip) :
    accrualStart rec I ≤ accrualStart rec Ip := by
  unfold accrualStart
  by_cases hr : rec = 0
  · subst hr
    simp only [ite_true]
    by_cases h1 : compInitialIndex ≤ I
    · have h2 : compInitialIndex ≤ Ip := Nat.le_trans h1 h
      simp only [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
      exact Nat.le_refl _
    · by_cases h2 : compInitialIndex ≤ Ip
      · simp only [if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
        exact Nat.le_refl _
  · simp [hr]

theorem accrualStart_self (x : Nat) : accrualStart x x = x := by
  unfold accrualStart
  by_cases hr : x = 0
  · subst hr
    simp only [ite_true]
    by_cases h : compInitialIndex ≤ 0
    · have hz : compInitialIndex = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
      have hne : compInitialIndex ≠ 0 := by unfold compInitialIndex; decide
      contradiction
    · simp [h]
  · simp [hr]

theorem div_mul_le_self (X total : Nat) : (X / total) * total ≤ X := by
  by_cases ht : total = 0
  · simp [ht]
  · have h := Nat.div_add_mod X total
    have heq : X / total * total + X % total = X := by
      have h2 : total * (X / total) + X % total = X := h
      rw [Nat.mul_comm] at h2
      exact h2
    omega

theorem credit_scaled_le (u s idx : Nat) :
    (creditFor u s idx) * doubleScale ≤ u * (idx - s) := by
  unfold creditFor
  by_cases hs : s ≤ idx
  · have h1 : u * (idx - s) / doubleScale * doubleScale ≤ u * (idx - s) :=
      div_mul_le_self _ _
    exact h1
  · have hsub : idx - s = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_ge hs)
    rw [hsub, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_div, Nat.zero_mul]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem pend_step_le (u r I Ip : Nat) (hrI : r ≤ I) (hII : I ≤ Ip) :
    u * (Ip - accrualStart r Ip) ≤ u * (I - accrualStart r I) + u * (Ip - I) := by
  have h1 : accrualStart r I ≤ I := accrualStart_le r I hrI
  have hrIp : r ≤ Ip := Nat.le_trans hrI hII
  have h2 : accrualStart r Ip ≤ Ip := accrualStart_le r Ip hrIp
  have hm : accrualStart r I ≤ accrualStart r Ip := accrualStart_mono hII
  have hle : Ip - accrualStart r Ip ≤ (I - accrualStart r I) + (Ip - I) := by omega
  calc u * (Ip - accrualStart r Ip) ≤ u * ((I - accrualStart r I) + (Ip - I)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left u hle
    _ = u * (I - accrualStart r I) + u * (Ip - I) := Nat.mul_add _ _ _

theorem accrue_delta_bound (sd : Side) (now total : Nat) :
    total * ((accrueSide sd now total).index - sd.index) ≤
      (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale := by
  unfold accrueSide
  by_cases h : (0 < now - sd.block ∧ 0 < sd.speed ∧ 0 < total)
  · rw [if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
    have heq2 : sd.index + (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total - sd.index =
        (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total := Nat.add_sub_cancel_left _ _
    rw [heq2]
    have hle : (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total * total ≤
        (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale := div_mul_le_self _ _
    have heq : total * ((now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total) =
        (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total * total := Nat.mul_comm _ _
    rw [heq]; exact hle
  · rw [if_neg h]
    simp

theorem sumSP_accrue_le (l : List Acct) (I Ip : Nat) (hII : I ≤ Ip) (D : Nat)
    (hD : Ip - I = D) (hr : ∀ a ∈ l, a.supplierIndex ≤ I) :
    (l.map fun a => a.supply * (Ip - accrualStart a.supplierIndex Ip)).sum ≤
      (l.map fun a => a.supply * (I - accrualStart a.supplierIndex I)).sum +
        (l.map Acct.supply).sum * D := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [hD]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hhd_mem : hd.supplierIndex ≤ I := hr hd (by simp)
    have htl : ∀ a ∈ tl, a.supplierIndex ≤ I := fun a ha => hr a (List.mem_cons_of_mem hd ha)
    have ih' := ih htl
    have hper0 := pend_step_le hd.supply hd.supplierIndex I Ip hhd_mem hII
    have hper : hd.supply * (Ip - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex Ip) ≤
        hd.supply * (I - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex I) + hd.supply * D := by
      have heq : hd.supply * (Ip - I) = hd.supply * D := by rw [hD]
      rw [heq] at hper0
      exact hper0
    have hdist : (hd.supply + (List.map Acct.supply tl).sum) * D =
        hd.supply * D + (List.map Acct.supply tl).sum * D := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
    have hgoal : hd.supply * (Ip - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex Ip) +
        (List.map (fun a => a.supply * (Ip - accrualStart a.supplierIndex Ip)) tl).sum ≤
        (hd.supply * (I - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex I) +
          (List.map (fun a => a.supply * (I - accrualStart a.supplierIndex I)) tl).sum) +
        (hd.supply + (List.map Acct.supply tl).sum) * D := by
      rw [hdist]
      omega
    exact hgoal

theorem sumBP_accrue_le (l : List Acct) (I Ip : Nat) (hII : I ≤ Ip) (D : Nat)
    (hD : Ip - I = D) (hr : ∀ a ∈ l, a.borrowerIndex ≤ I) :
    (l.map fun a => a.borrow * (Ip - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex Ip)).sum ≤
      (l.map fun a => a.borrow * (I - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex I)).sum +
        (l.map Acct.borrow).sum * D := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [hD]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hhd_mem : hd.borrowerIndex ≤ I := hr hd (by simp)
    have htl : ∀ a ∈ tl, a.borrowerIndex ≤ I := fun a ha => hr a (List.mem_cons_of_mem hd ha)
    have ih' := ih htl
    have hper0 := pend_step_le hd.borrow hd.borrowerIndex I Ip hhd_mem hII
    have hper : hd.borrow * (Ip - accrualStart hd.borrowerIndex Ip) ≤
        hd.borrow * (I - accrualStart hd.borrowerIndex I) + hd.borrow * D := by
      have heq : hd.borrow * (Ip - I) = hd.borrow * D := by rw [hD]
      rw [heq] at hper0
      exact hper0
    have hdist : (hd.borrow + (List.map Acct.borrow tl).sum) * D =
        hd.borrow * D + (List.map Acct.borrow tl).sum * D := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
    have hgoal : hd.borrow * (Ip - accrualStart hd.borrowerIndex Ip) +
        (List.map (fun a => a.borrow * (Ip - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex Ip)) tl).sum ≤

def sPend (s : St) (a : Acct) : Nat :=
  a.supply * (s.supplyState.index - accrualStart a.supplierIndex s.supplyState.index)
def bPend (s : St) (a : Acct) : Nat :=
  a.borrow * (s.borrowState.index - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
def Usup (s : St) : Nat := (s.blockNumber - s.supplyState.block) * s.supplyState.speed
def Ubor (s : St) : Nat := (s.blockNumber - s.borrowState.block) * s.borrowState.speed
def sumSP (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => sPend s a).sum
def sumBP (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => bPend s a).sum

  (St.credited s) * doubleScale + sumSP s + sumBP s + (Usup s + Ubor s) * doubleScale

  (St.creditedTo s who) * doubleScale + sPend s (s.acct who) + bPend s (s.acct who) +
    (if 0 < (s.acct who).supply then Usup s * doubleScale else 0) +
    (if 0 < (s.acct who).borrow then Ubor s * doubleScale else 0)

theorem accrualStart_mono {rec I Ip : Nat} (h : I ≤ Ip) :
    accrualStart rec I ≤ accrualStart rec Ip := by
  unfold accrualStart
  by_cases hr : rec = 0
  · subst hr
    simp only [ite_true]
    by_cases h1 : compInitialIndex ≤ I
    · have h2 : compInitialIndex ≤ Ip := Nat.le_trans h1 h
      simp only [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
      exact Nat.le_refl _
    · by_cases h2 : compInitialIndex ≤ Ip
      · simp only [if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
        exact Nat.le_refl _
  · simp [hr]

theorem accrualStart_self (x : Nat) : accrualStart x x = x := by
  unfold accrualStart
  by_cases hr : x = 0
  · subst hr
    simp only [ite_true]
    by_cases h : compInitialIndex ≤ 0
    · have hz : compInitialIndex = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
      have hne : compInitialIndex ≠ 0 := by unfold compInitialIndex; decide
      contradiction
    · simp [h]
  · simp [hr]

theorem div_mul_le_self (X total : Nat) : (X / total) * total ≤ X := by
  by_cases ht : total = 0
  · simp [ht]
  · have h := Nat.div_add_mod X total
    have heq : X / total * total + X % total = X := by
      have h2 : total * (X / total) + X % total = X := h
      rw [Nat.mul_comm] at h2
      exact h2
    omega

theorem credit_scaled_le (u s idx : Nat) :
    (creditFor u s idx) * doubleScale ≤ u * (idx - s) := by
  unfold creditFor
  by_cases hs : s ≤ idx
  · have h1 : u * (idx - s) / doubleScale * doubleScale ≤ u * (idx - s) :=
      div_mul_le_self _ _
    exact h1
  · have hsub : idx - s = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_ge hs)
    rw [hsub, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_div, Nat.zero_mul]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem pend_step_le (u r I Ip : Nat) (hrI : r ≤ I) (hII : I ≤ Ip) :
    u * (Ip - accrualStart r Ip) ≤ u * (I - accrualStart r I) + u * (Ip - I) := by
  have h1 : accrualStart r I ≤ I := accrualStart_le r I hrI
  have hrIp : r ≤ Ip := Nat.le_trans hrI hII
  have h2 : accrualStart r Ip ≤ Ip := accrualStart_le r Ip hrIp
  have hm : accrualStart r I ≤ accrualStart r Ip := accrualStart_mono hII
  have hle : Ip - accrualStart r Ip ≤ (I - accrualStart r I) + (Ip - I) := by omega
  calc u * (Ip - accrualStart r Ip) ≤ u * ((I - accrualStart r I) + (Ip - I)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left u hle
    _ = u * (I - accrualStart r I) + u * (Ip - I) := Nat.mul_add _ _ _

theorem accrue_delta_bound (sd : Side) (now total : Nat) :
    total * ((accrueSide sd now total).index - sd.index) ≤
      (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale := by
  unfold accrueSide
  by_cases h : (0 < now - sd.block ∧ 0 < sd.speed ∧ 0 < total)
  · rw [if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
    have heq2 : sd.index + (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total - sd.index =
        (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total := Nat.add_sub_cancel_left _ _
    rw [heq2]
    have hle : (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total * total ≤
        (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale := div_mul_le_self _ _
    have heq : total * ((now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total) =
        (now - sd.block) * sd.speed * doubleScale / total * total := Nat.mul_comm _ _
    rw [heq]; exact hle
  · rw [if_neg h]
    simp

theorem sumSP_accrue_le (l : List Acct) (I Ip : Nat) (hII : I ≤ Ip) (D : Nat)
    (hD : Ip - I = D) (hr : ∀ a ∈ l, a.supplierIndex ≤ I) :
    (l.map fun a => a.supply * (Ip - accrualStart a.supplierIndex Ip)).sum ≤
      (l.map fun a => a.supply * (I - accrualStart a.supplierIndex I)).sum +
        (l.map Acct.supply).sum * D := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [hD]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hhd_mem : hd.supplierIndex ≤ I := hr hd (by simp)
    have htl : ∀ a ∈ tl, a.supplierIndex ≤ I := fun a ha => hr a (List.mem_cons_of_mem hd ha)
    have ih' := ih htl
    have hper0 := pend_step_le hd.supply hd.supplierIndex I Ip hhd_mem hII
    have hper : hd.supply * (Ip - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex Ip) ≤
        hd.supply * (I - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex I) + hd.supply * D := by
      have heq : hd.supply * (Ip - I) = hd.supply * D := by rw [hD]
      rw [heq] at hper0
      exact hper0
    have hdist : (hd.supply + (List.map Acct.supply tl).sum) * D =
        hd.supply * D + (List.map Acct.supply tl).sum * D := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
    have hgoal : hd.supply * (Ip - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex Ip) +
        (List.map (fun a => a.supply * (Ip - accrualStart a.supplierIndex Ip)) tl).sum ≤
        (hd.supply * (I - accrualStart hd.supplierIndex I) +
          (List.map (fun a => a.supply * (I - accrualStart a.supplierIndex I)) tl).sum) +
        (hd.supply + (List.map Acct.supply tl).sum) * D := by
      rw [hdist]
      omega
    exact hgoal

theorem sumBP_accrue_le (l : List Acct) (I Ip : Nat) (hII : I ≤ Ip) (D : Nat)
    (hD : Ip - I = D) (hr : ∀ a ∈ l, a.borrowerIndex ≤ I) :
    (l.map fun a => a.borrow * (Ip - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex Ip)).sum ≤
      (l.map fun a => a.borrow * (I - accrualStart a.borrowerIndex I)).sum +
        (l.map Acct.borrow).sum * D := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [hD]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hhd_mem : hd.borrowerIndex ≤ I := hr hd (by simp)
    have htl : ∀ a ∈ tl, a.borrowerIndex ≤ I := fun a ha => hr a (List.mem_cons_of_mem hd ha)
